observations: Photos show a car drivetrain assembly on the ground: an engine with attached transmission/gearbox and suspension struts (front suspension pieces) around it.
Large black engine cover with a circular cap/feature on top; red-painted brackets/parts visible on both sides.
No clear readable brand/model plate, engine code, or VIN/part number is visible in the provided images.
Wiring/hoses and some components appear disconnected; the assembly looks like it was removed from a vehicle (not a complete car).
Seller text is generic and does not specify the exact part shown in the photos.

claims.claim: We also deals on all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: Seller statement only; photos do not confirm the business scope or inventory.

risks.risk: Exact item identification is unclear (engine only vs engine+gearbox vs full front sub-assembly). Wrong identification leads to wrong pricing and wrong compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine/transmission ID plate or stamped engine code/part number (close-up, readable), plus the vehicle make/model/year it came from.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a mixed/unknown used drivetrain assembly with compatibility risk (worst case: not guaranteed to match your car).

risks.risk: Unknown condition (running status, internal damage, oil/water leaks). Photos cannot confirm whether it works.
risks.proof: Video of the engine/transmission running (or at least cranking) and a short clip showing no abnormal smoke/leaks, plus compression test or diagnostic scan results if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / for parts only.

risks.risk: Missing parts or incomplete assembly (some hoses/connectors/bolts may be missing).
risks.proof: Photo checklist: underside and both sides showing all major connections, and a count/confirmation of included components (starter, alternator, sensors, mounts, etc.).

risks.risk: Compatibility risk for Abuja buyers (engine mounts, gearbox type, ECU/sensors, drivetrain configuration).
risks.proof: Provide the donor vehicle details (make/model/year/engine size) and the exact engine code; also show gearbox code/label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring matching/verification (worst case: may not fit).

proof_requests: Close-up, readable engine code/ID plate and transmission/gearbox code/ID label (photos).
Donor vehicle details: make/model/year and engine size, plus drivetrain type (photo of VIN/registration if possible with sensitive parts covered).
Video proof: engine cranking/running and brief leak/smoke check.
Confirm what is included/excluded (list of parts included in the sale) with photos of all sides.
response.reason: The photos show a used drivetrain/engine assembly, but the exact part identity and condition (working vs not, completeness, compatibility) cannot be confirmed from the images. Without readable codes/vehicle details and proof of condition, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
